Gautam Adani Regains Title of India's Richest Person

Gautam Adani has reclaimed the position of India's wealthiest individual with a net worth of $112.7 billion, surpassing Mukesh Ambani, who is now second with $86.3 billion. Adani's wealth increased by $20.7 billion, attributed to his infrastructure ventures, despite a challenging market year in India.
